verses.pali: “Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without giving up ten things you can’t realize perfection.

verses.pali: Rāgaṁ, dosaṁ, mohaṁ, kodhaṁ, upanāhaṁ, makkhaṁ, paḷāsaṁ, issaṁ, macchariyaṁ, mānaṁ—
verses.english: Greed, hate, delusion, anger, acrimony, disdain, contempt, jealousy, stinginess, and conceit.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: Without giving up these ten things you can’t realize perfection.

verses.pali: Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: After giving up ten things you can realize perfection.

verses.pali: Rāgaṁ, dosaṁ, mohaṁ, kodhaṁ, upanāhaṁ, makkhaṁ, paḷāsaṁ, issaṁ, macchariyaṁ, mānaṁ—
verses.english: Greed, hate, delusion, anger, acrimony, disdain, contempt, jealousy, stinginess, and conceit.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātun”ti.
verses.english: After giving up these ten things you can realize perfection.”
